profile: early stopping: a regularization strategy for tuning high-capacity models. It is straightforward and requires only slight adjustments to the typical use of local optimization. In practice, one makes a run of local optimization, tuning all model parameters, and then uses the set of weights from that run at which the model achieves minimum validation error.
